A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same work and contain the main text and Appendices A–I. The text, equations, tables, figures, and appendix examples support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original PDDL synthesis and planning experiments, initialization studies, and qualitative human-in-the-loop results in Appendix I.

after.justification: v2 retains these empirical results and adds model configurations in Table 2 and an oracle-interaction comparison in Table 5.

M1.justification: Both versions use likelihood-ranked BoN initialization followed by alternating LLM critique and iVML updates, then classical planning. The revised notation, temperature explanation, and description of intermediate thoughts clarify the existing procedure without changing it.

E1.justification: Both retain the 283-domain NL2Domain and 332-domain Prob2Domain coverage, Planetarium problem generation, and the same six planning domains. The appendix cases and graduate-student human-in-the-loop study are also retained.

E2.justification: Table 5 adds the oracle-interaction PDDL method associated with Mahdavi et al., implemented with Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and reporting results on four existing domains. The previous direct-planning and Planetarium comparator sets remain.

E3.justification: Table 2 adds BoN-8 and five-iteration iVML configurations for Yi-1.5-Chat-9B, plus a Llama3.1-8B BoN-8 configuration. Section 4.4 corrects the stated Llama initialization from BoN-8 to BoN-4, matching the figure label already present in v1; this does not establish a rerun.

E4.justification: The convergence and initialization analyses in Sections 4.3–4.4, action-level error cases in Table 3, and appendix qualitative studies retain their questions and evidence. Rescaling the plots and redesigning the Termes illustrations do not introduce a new analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or statistical uncertainty estimates. The added result rows retain the same point-estimate reporting practice.

E6.justification: Table 2 adds Yi and Llama results, including 93.9%/93.0% for the reported Yi-1.5-Chat-9B iVML configuration, and corrects the Qwen2.5-Instruct-3B average from 0.0% to 1.8%. Table 5 adds oracle scores of 0.0 on Floortile and Grippers and 100.0 on Termes and Blockworld. Existing headline results remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Section 3.2 adds an explicit mathematical definition of the temperature-scaled token distribution in Equation (1), previously described verbally. The optimization objective, iterative update equations, and formal planning formulations in Appendices A–B remain unchanged; no proofs or theoretical guarantees are added.

C1.justification: The central contributions remain unchanged, but the introduction changes 41.7% and 33.7% from reported o1 baseline accuracies into claimed improvement margins over o1-mini. This quantitative claim is inconsistent with Table 2, which implies margins of 43.5 and 37.7 percentage points.

C2.justification: v2 adds an interpretation of oracle-independent synthesis as supporting scalability without ground-truth feedback. New Section 6 links symbolic world modeling to scientist AI, transparency, and safer agents. The existing semantic-verification and idealized-simulation limitations are retained.

D1.justification: Sections 4.1, 4.5, and 4.6 newly specify goal matching for problem synthesis, exact reference-plan matching for planning accuracy, and the absence of an input PDDL domain in problem generation. These are disclosures about existing experiments, not demonstrated protocol changes. Section 3 also clarifies intermediate-thought outputs and candidate indexing.

R1.justification: Section 2.2 substantially expands positioning against oracle-assisted PDDL synthesis, adding Mahdavi, Oswald, and Smirnov and extending Table 1. Section 2.1 develops the distinction between conventional and reasoning-focused LLMs, while Section 6 introduces scientist-AI and autonomous-agent safety positioning. These changes go beyond bibliographic updates.

P1.justification: v2 revises selected introductory, related-work, method, and experimental paragraphs, adds an experiment roadmap and Broader Impact section, and clarifies terminology. The main narrative sequence and appendix organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is substantially redesigned; Figure 1 gains clearer candidate indexing; Figure 3 swaps panels; and Figures 3–5 replace count axes with validation percentages. Figure 6 is reoriented, Tables 1, 2, and 5 are expanded, and the document adopts a different journal layout and typography.

improvement.justification: v2 provides a useful oracle-assisted comparator, additional main-table model results, clearer evaluation definitions, and more informative figures. These improve the paper's assessability without resolving its existing semantic-validation limitations. The gain is limited by new reporting inconsistencies, particularly the introduction's incorrect improvement margins and the Yi row's gain annotations, which do not match its stated baseline.
